profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager | Creator | Tech Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Currently a Software Engineering Manager for Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Company focusing on developing a team to develop object-oriented design and oversee the full life cycle of the software design process including requirements definition, prototyping, user interface development, testing, and maintenance.

I just finished my term as the 2023-2024 National Professionals Chair for the National Society of Black Engineers.  I oversee a nearly 4,000 member base consisting of industry professionals and leaders in academia.  My team services the 80+ Professional chapters located in cities across the US, Africa, the Caribbean, and South America. 

Some background about me: I'm a multi-faceted software engineer specializing in Java, C++, C, and object-oriented design.  An extensive background in web and print design, including web development, publications, marketing materials and animation prototypes.  A keen eye for design and aesthetics, demonstrated understanding and ability to develop innovative and refreshing design concepts under tight conditions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I currently work as a software engineer utilizing my skills in computer programming and network/database design.

positions.title: Independent Graphic Designer
positions.description: Develop conceptual designs for small businesses ranging from logos and business cards to informational brochures and websites.

positions.description: Now serving as your 2023-2024 Professionals Chair for the National Society of Black Engineers. Stay tuned for more content as I bring you in to the behind the scenes workings of the Professionals.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Information Systems with an emphasis in Web Application Development
